editors.after: const P='http://172.29.0.95:9090';const servers=[{name:'PC-ME',cpu:'100-(avg by(server_name)(rate(windows_cpu_time_total{mode="idle",server_name="PC-ME"}[2m]))*100)',ram:'100-(windows_memory_physical_free_bytes{server_name="PC-ME"}/windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{server_name="PC-ME"}*100)',svc:'host.docker.internal'},{name:'PC-IT',cpu:'100-(avg by(server_name)(rate(windows_cpu_time_total{mode="idle",server_name="PC-IT"}[2m]))*100)',ram:'100-(windows_memory_physical_free_bytes{server_name="PC-IT"}/windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{server_name="PC-IT"}*100)',svc:'172.29.1.61'},{name:'Server',cpu:'100-(avg by(server_name)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle",server_name="Server"}[2m]))*100)',ram:'100-(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{server_name="Server"}/node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{server_name="Server"}*100)',svc:'172.17.0.12'}];const q=e=>fetch(P+'/api/v1/query?query='+encodeURIComponent(e)).then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>d.data&&d.data.result||[]).catch(()=>[]);const v=r=>r[0]?parseFloat(r[0].value[1]).toFixed(1):null;const sc=(c,r)=>c===null&&r===null?{t:'DOWN',c:'#ef4444'}:(c>=85||r>=85)?{t:'WARN',c:'#f59e0b'}:{t:'UP',c:'#10b981'};async function load(){const rows=await Promise.all(servers.map(async s=>{const[c,r,sv]=await Promise.all([q(s.cpu),q(s.ram),q('probe_success{instance=~"'+s.svc+'.*"}')]);const cpu=v(c),ram=v(r);const up=sv.filter(x=>x.value[1]==='1').length;return{name:s.name,cpu,ram,up,total:sv.length,st:sc(cpu,ram)};}));const tb=document.getElementById('slist-body');if(tb)tb.innerHTML=rows.map(r=>''+r.name+''+r.st.t+''+( r.cpu!==null?r.cpu+'%':'—')+''+( r.ram!==null?r.ram+'%':'—')+''+r.up+'/'+r.total+' UP').join('');}load();const t=setInterval(load,30000);return()=>clearInterval(t);

const AM='http://172.29.0.95:9093';const servers=['PC-ME','PC-IT','Server'];const getSilences=()=>fetch(AM+'/api/v2/silences').then(r=>r.json()).catch(()=>[]);const isMuted=(sl,s)=>sl.some(x=>x.status&&x.status.state==='active'&&x.matchers&&x.matchers.some(m=>m.name==='server_name'&&m.value===s));const doSilence=s=>{const now=new Date();const end=new Date(now.getTime()+1000*3650*24*3600);return fetch(AM+'/api/v2/silences',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({matchers:[{name:'server_name',value:s,isRegex:false,isEqual:true}],startsAt:now.toISOString(),endsAt:end.toISOString(),createdBy:'grafana-dashboard',comment:'Muted from Dashboard'})}).then(r=>r.json());};const doUnsilence=async s=>{const sl=await getSilences();const a=sl.find(x=>x.status&&x.status.state==='active'&&x.matchers&&x.matchers.some(m=>m.name==='server_name'&&m.value===s));if(a)await fetch(AM+'/api/v2/silence/'+a.id,{method:'DELETE'});};const toast=(msg,ok)=>{const t=document.getElementById('tg-toast');if(!t)return;t.textContent=msg;t.style.display='block';t.style.background=ok?'rgba(16,185,129,0.15)':'rgba(239,68,68,0.15)';t.style.color=ok?'#10b981':'#ef4444';setTimeout(()=>t.style.display='none',3000);};async function render(){const sl=await getSilences();const list=document.getElementById('tg-list');if(!list)return;list.innerHTML=servers.map(s=>{const m=isMuted(sl,s);return'
'+s+'
'+( m?'🔕 ปิดแจ้งเตือน':'🔔 เปิดแจ้งเตือน')+'
';}).join('');document.querySelectorAll('.tg-cb').forEach(cb=>{cb.addEventListener('change',async function(){const s=this.dataset.server;try{if(!this.checked){await doSilence(s);toast('ปิดแจ้งเตือน '+s+' แล้ว',false);}else{await doUnsilence(s);toast('เปิดแจ้งเตือน '+s+' แล้ว',true);}setTimeout(render,800);}catch(e){this.checked=!this.checked;toast('Error: '+e.message,false);}});});}render();const t=setInterval(render,30000);return()=>clearInterval(t);
